subject: Re: Kickoff: state-similarity service - decision on sweep scope
body:
Decision: we go with Efe's proposal. 20 games, full pair sampling, quality over coverage. The service pitch depends on the metric being trustworthy, not on the game count - 20 is plenty for the API draft.

Two follow-ups:

1) The June sweep on our reserved week stays the plan of record. Fumiko, you're at 40% from next week specifically to have the sweep harness dry-run by Jun 5. One clean dry run on 8 accelerators before we spend the big reservation, please.

2) For Q3 planning (OKRs lock Jun 26): I'm writing the state-similarity API as a Q3 deliverable, with the June sweep results as evidence. Ivo, send me your Q3 headcount ask by Jun 12 so I can fold it in.

And thanks Carmen for the 40x40 validation - that went straight into the leadership deck.

Dmitri
